Name: Penny's New Clothes
Author: prettypinktardis
Description:
Penny needed a comfy sweater so I gave her one! also i recolored her other clothes except the flower dance and wedding dresses. AND ALSO, i recolored the sprites to match her portrait.

download manually
open up the zip file
navigate to your stardew valley content folder
drag and drop the mod files into your content folder
override the files
